glosses: loot, booty (the proceeds of theft, robbery etc., swag, contraband)
what is obtained or amassed by laborious collection
what is collected by insects such as bees or ants; a load of pollen, nectar, etc.

examples.text: On partage le butin en trois.
examples.en: We split the loot three ways.

examples.text: Les voleurs se partagèrent le butin.
examples.en: The thieves divvied up the stolen loot among themselves.

examples.text: Les voleurs ont partagé leur butin.
examples.en: The thieves split up their loot.

examples.text: Les voleurs sont partis avec un sacré butin.
examples.en: The thieves made off with quite a haul.
